name: AIVS Intelligence Extension
description: Adds the properties defenders work from to the STIX vulnerability, course-of-action, indicator and note SDOs: SSVC decision points, EPSS, CISA KEV status and CVSS v3.1 on a vulnerability, with affected versions as vers ranges; the CSAF remediation category, restart requirement and a way to verify the fix on a course of action; the telemetry an indicator needs and what else it matches; and, on a note about a vulnerability, the conditions that make it exploitable (2.1). Standards' vocabularies are adopted verbatim. Supersedes the AIVS Pre-CVE AI Vulnerability Extension on vulnerability objects, which remains accepted.
